case_title: CITY OF PHILADELPHIA vs. DIAL INFO INC.

docket_entries.description: APPLICATION FOR ENTRY OF SISTER STATE JUDGMENT; NOTICE OF SISTER STATE JUDGMENT ISSUED FILED BY PLAINTIFF CITY OF PHILADELPHIA AS TO DEFENDANT DIAL INFO INC.

UNDER APPLICATION TO THE CLERK FOR JUDGMENT UNDER SEC 1710.25 C.C.P., IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF CITY OF PHILADELPHIA RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT DIAL INFO INC. $3,632.00 PRINCIPAL, $1,129.80 INTEREST, $80.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $4,841.80 ALL FURTHER PROCESSING TO BE DONE BY DEFAULT SECTION
